title: Abelian groups admit functorial flat resolutions
statement: For every universe $\mathcal U$, give the category $\operatorname{Ab}_{\mathcal U}$ of $\mathcal U$-small abelian groups its tensor product over $\mathbf Z$, with unit $\mathbf Z$ and internal hom the group of homomorphisms, as in [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. Call an object flat if tensoring with it on either side preserves short exact sequences. There is a functor $P:\operatorname{Ab}_{\mathcal U}\to\operatorname{Ab}_{\mathcal U}$ with flat values and a natural transformation $\pi:P\to\operatorname{id}$ such that every $\pi_M$ is an epimorphism. Thus this category admits functorial flat resolutions in the sense of [lem-sfb-sheaf-functorial-flat-resolution].
